applications.name: Meltdown
applications.description: At the start of the fight, the Attacker is afflicted with a Meltdown Timer for 30 second(s). Whenever the owner of the Meltdown Timer activates a Special Attack, the Meltdown Timer is refreshed and applied to their Opponent with -5 second(s). When the Meltdown Timer reaches zero, it deals it's owner a burst of damage equal to [16982bff]200%[-] of their Attack. It then resets back to 30 second(s) and applies itself to the Attacker.
applications.rawDescription: At the start of the fight, the Attacker is afflicted with a Meltdown Timer for {2} second(s). Whenever the owner of the Meltdown Timer activates a Special Attack, the Meltdown Timer is refreshed and applied to their Opponent with -{0} second(s). When the Meltdown Timer reaches zero, it deals it's owner a burst of damage equal to [16982bff]{1}%[-] of their Attack. It then resets back to {2} second(s) and applies itself to the Attacker.

applications.name: Redlining - 3
applications.description: While the Attacker has more than 33% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by 100%. If the Attacker has more than 75% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.
applications.rawDescription: While the Attacker has more than {1}% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by {0}%. If the Attacker has more than {2}% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.

applications.name: Steady Perseverance - 1

applications.name: Meltdown
applications.description: At the start of the fight, the Attacker is afflicted with a Meltdown Timer for 30 second(s). Whenever the owner of the Meltdown Timer activates a Special Attack, the Meltdown Timer is refreshed and applied to their Opponent with -5 second(s). When the Meltdown Timer reaches zero, it deals it's owner a burst of damage equal to [16982bff]200%[-] of their Attack. It then resets back to 30 second(s) and applies itself to the Attacker.
applications.rawDescription: At the start of the fight, the Attacker is afflicted with a Meltdown Timer for {2} second(s). Whenever the owner of the Meltdown Timer activates a Special Attack, the Meltdown Timer is refreshed and applied to their Opponent with -{0} second(s). When the Meltdown Timer reaches zero, it deals it's owner a burst of damage equal to [16982bff]{1}%[-] of their Attack. It then resets back to {2} second(s) and applies itself to the Attacker.

applications.name: Redlining - 3
applications.description: While the Attacker has more than 33% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by 100%. If the Attacker has more than 75% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.
applications.rawDescription: While the Attacker has more than {1}% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by {0}%. If the Attacker has more than {2}% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.

applications.name: Steady Perseverance - 1
applications.description: When the Defender activates a Special Attack, they gain a Stun Immunity Buff for 4 second(s) plus 2 second(s) for each of the Defender’s unique Buffs. This Buff is paused during the Defender’s Special Attacks.
applications.rawDescription: When the Defender activates a Special Attack, they gain a Stun Immunity Buff for {2} second(s) plus {1} second(s) for each of the Defender’s unique Buffs. This Buff is paused during the Defender’s Special Attacks.

applications.name: Meltdown
applications.description: At the start of the fight, the Attacker is afflicted with a Meltdown Timer for 30 second(s). Whenever the owner of the Meltdown Timer activates a Special Attack, the Meltdown Timer is refreshed and applied to their Opponent with -5 second(s). When the Meltdown Timer reaches zero, it deals it's owner a burst of damage equal to [16982bff]200%[-] of their Attack. It then resets back to 30 second(s) and applies itself to the Attacker.
applications.rawDescription: At the start of the fight, the Attacker is afflicted with a Meltdown Timer for {2} second(s). Whenever the owner of the Meltdown Timer activates a Special Attack, the Meltdown Timer is refreshed and applied to their Opponent with -{0} second(s). When the Meltdown Timer reaches zero, it deals it's owner a burst of damage equal to [16982bff]{1}%[-] of their Attack. It then resets back to {2} second(s) and applies itself to the Attacker.

applications.name: Redlining - 3
applications.description: While the Attacker has more than 33% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by 100%. If the Attacker has more than 75% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.
applications.rawDescription: While the Attacker has more than {1}% of their Max Power, their [k=glossary/combat_power_rate]Combat Power Rate[/k] is increased by {0}%. If the Attacker has more than {2}% of their Max Power, they are immediately Power Drained down to zero.
